description: Perception-completeness probes — elements the surfer may not see. /shadow-dom hosts buttons inside a Web Component's OPEN shadow root, which document.querySelectorAll (the surfer's element source) does NOT pierce. Measures whether the agent can perceive + act on shadow-DOM content.

scenarios.goal: Log in, go to the shadow DOM page at /shadow-dom, and click the first button inside the shadow component on that page.
